title: Ordering at a cafe
objectives: Order a drink and a snack politely
Ask about size and milk options
Understand the barista's questions about the order

courseTemplate.setting: A neighbourhood cafe during a quiet morning. The learner wants a drink and a snack to take away.

roles.partner: A patient barista who asks one short question at a time

courseTemplate.openingLine: Good morning! What can I get for you today?

targetPatterns.example: Could I have a latte and a muffin, please?
I'd like a regular latte to go.

stages.title: Order politely
stages.instruction: Invite the customer to order a drink and a snack. Ask what else they would like if either is missing.
successCriteria: The learner names both a drink and a snack.
The request includes a polite expression such as please or could I have.
hints: Try: Could I have a … and a …, please?

stages.title: Choose size and milk
stages.instruction: Offer regular or large and dairy or oat milk. Leave room for the customer to ask about options.
successCriteria: The learner asks about a size or milk option.
The learner specifies their preferred size and milk.
hints: Ask: Do you have oat milk?
You can ask: What sizes do you have?

stages.title: Confirm the order
stages.instruction: Ask whether the order is for here or to go, then read it back for confirmation.
successCriteria: The learner answers the for here or to go question appropriately.
The learner confirms or corrects the final order.
hints: To go means you will take the order away.
You can confirm with: Yes, that is right, thank you.
